# seekrit_environment (Data Source)

An existing environment, looked up either by `id` or by its owner (`application_id` or `group_id`) plus `slug`. The pair is how you address an environment you did not create in Terraform — for example to grant a Terraform-managed token access to the `production` environment of an app the dashboard owns.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By id.
data "seekrit_environment" "by_id" {
  id = "env_9QpZ3vLmKd8"
}

# Or by owner plus slug, which is how you address an environment you did not
# create in Terraform — an owner's slugs are stable, its ids are not memorable.
data "seekrit_environment" "production" {
  application_id = data.seekrit_application.web.id
  slug           = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) The owning application id, when looking up by owner + `slug`.
- `group_id` (String) The owning group id, when looking up by owner + `slug`.
- `id` (String) The environment id (`env_…`). Set this, or an owner plus `slug` — not both.
- `slug` (String) The environment slug, unique within its owner.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (ISO 8601).
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (ISO 8601).
